deflation.note: a margin, not a p-value: the tabulated null keeps moments rather than draws, so the distribution of the maximum is not available and any rate quoted here would be an approximation dressed as a measurement

diagnostics_only.note: BH and Holm over the tabulated FAR column are DIAGNOSTICS. The column is one strategy's null (Task 30 measured 10-17x its stated rate for candidates that trade differently), and N <= q(R+1) caps how large a campaign a per-trial p-value can survive at all.

gate.note: no per-candidate nulls supplied, so this campaign has no accept decision. BH over the tabulated column is not a substitute -- see docs/design/metric.md.

resolution.note: max_of_n resamples each null with replacement, so a small null truncates its own upper tail and the test is liberal by about `resampling_bias`. Measured, not assumed: docs/reviews/task34/bias-grid.json.

uncorrected.reading: what a report with no correction would say: the best of 1 candidates scored -0.2889 at a nominal false-acceptance rate of 0.5
